problems: Each individual material ramp (green leaves, red-brown canes) has only 2-3 shading steps because the small palette is split across leaves, red stems, purple fill, and beige thorns
Green leaves are rendered as three isolated, icon-like cross patches rather than layered foliage clusters
Diagonal red canes read as flat 1px ribbons without volume, and the bottom edge forms a rigid horizontal line
reason: Although the dark brown outline and pixel density per tile are acceptable, splitting the limited palette across four distinct hues leaves both the leaf clusters and the stems with only 2-3 shading steps instead of the required 4+. Strict judgment requires a fail on insufficient per-material shading depth and weak foliage cluster form.
